inventory_groups.reason: Import-order exceptions support explicit path bootstrapping or re-exports; type-checker directives predate a governed Python type checker and must not expand.

inventory_groups.reason: Three @ts-ignore directives exercise assumptions that the public Pattern value is callable; changing the product contract is outside this hardgate task.

inventory_groups.reason: ts-jest diagnostic 151002 recommends isolatedModules for the NodeNext transform, but controlled adoption caused all 19 Jest suites to fail before execution while strict tsc remained clean.
inventory_groups.retirement_condition: Remove the exact-code waiver when the governed Jest/ts-jest ESM transform supports isolatedModules or stops emitting diagnostic 151002 after a separately authorized dependency/toolchain transition.

inventory_groups.reason: Four C setup directives permit intentional package-list word splitting; three directives belong to the upstream Gradle wrapper portability implementation.

waivers.reason: Three tests suppress type errors around the potentially semantic callable-Pattern public contract.

waivers.reason: The governed ts-jest 29.1.2 ESM transform emits diagnostic 151002 under NodeNext; enabling isolatedModules caused every TypeScript test suite to fail before executing, while the authoritative strict tsc check remains clean.

waivers.reason: The C setup script intentionally expands package lists and the repository-managed Gradle wrapper carries upstream portability directives.
